title: Training
summary: New therapists complete a two-week unpaid training period before paid work.

sections.title: Training
paragraphs: All new therapists are required to complete a two-week unpaid training period before resuming regular paid work. The training period is used to teach Zura Spa standards, massage techniques, client handling, communication, hygiene, boundaries, teamwork, and operating procedures.

Successful completion of the training does not automatically guarantee continued engagement; the therapist must demonstrate the required attitude, competence, professionalism, and willingness to follow Zura Spa standards.

remember: Training is unpaid for two weeks and does not automatically guarantee continued engagement.
